data.description: A teenager wearing a soaked marching-band jacket who seeks help broadcasting a missing dog announcement during a post-disaster shelter operation. She is resourceful, emotionally connected to her pet, and present during the community radio station's early operations.
data.dialogue_summary: Maya requests that the community radio station broadcast an announcement for her missing dog, Comet. She explains that Comet slept through the evacuation and stole her grilled cheese. She spells out the dog's name phonetically for the broadcast. Later, she reports finding Comet under the vending machine in the band room.
